name: checkpoint
description: Context checkpoints for Even Keel chain sessions of Claude Code and Codex: once the context passes 200k tokens (and every 50k after, every 25k past 250k), the session is asked to write a handoff note and end its turn with `CHECKPOINT: <path>`, so that Even Keel continues the task in a fresh session instead of re-reading the whole context on every turn. A session that writes the note but forgets the line is sent back to add it. The context and the note come from Even Keel, which reads the transcripts of both agents, so a session it did not start is left alone. The first threshold is the project's calibrated one, and a task that has had three handoffs is asked only from 300k; on a small context window the late and hard thresholds come down to 85 % and 95 % of it. Thresholds: CHECKPOINT_FIRST_TOKENS, CHECKPOINT_STEP_TOKENS, CHECKPOINT_LATE_TOKENS, CHECKPOINT_LATE_STEP_TOKENS, CHECKPOINT_HARD_TOKENS and CHECKPOINT_MAX_HANDOFFS. In a chain session of a project without a CI to judge its main branch, the merge of the task branch waits for the project's check commands from Even Keel and is blocked while they fail. A message the user writes from Even Keel's chat to a working session reaches it mid-turn: before or after its next tool call, at its stop (the turn goes on), or in place of a question it was about to ask.
